Stops and parking spaces for touristic coaches registered by Brussels Mobility and located on the territory of the City of Brussels More info:. Coverage: City of Brussels. The portal files it under Mobility. Its keywords are Parking, Parking, mobility, coaches, touristic coaches, tourism. The portal shows 3 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-03 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-brussels-be-portal.
